items.html: And there are seven corrections in this Rosh of AA, through which Atik, which clothes within them, shines. And these are: first, one skull, which is the Galgalta of AA, called the Keter of AA. Second, the dew of bdellium, and it is the brain of AA, called its Hochma. Third, the membrane of the air that was clarified and sealed, which is the secret of the membrane that surrounds the brain and separates between it and the skull. Fourth, the pure wool that hangs in the scales, which are the aspect of the ears, where the hairs of the Rosh of AA, which are like pure wool, hang behind those ears, and these hairs hang in equal scales.
